verses.en: Nūn , by the pen and what they write,
with the grace of your Lord, you are not insane.
And you will definitely have a reward that will never end.
And you are surely on an excellent standard of character.
So, you will see, and they will see
which of you is demented.

verses.ar: اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ ضَلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖࣕ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُهۡتَدِيۡنَ
verses.en: Surely your Lord knows best who has strayed from his way, and He is well aware of those who are on the right path.
So, do not obey those who reject (the true faith.)
They wish that you become flexible (in your faith), so that they should become flexible (in their hostile attitude.)
And do not obey any contemptible one who swears much,
a slanderer who goes about with calumnies,
one who prevents good, (and who is) transgressor, sinful,
harsh, (and) after all that, notorious,
(do not obey such a person merely) because he is a man of wealth and sons.

verses.ar: اِذَا تُتۡلٰي عَلَيۡهِ اٰيٰتُنَا قَالَ اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَ
verses.en: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “(These are) the tales of the ancient.”
We will soon brand him on the snout.

verses.ar: اِنَّا بَلَوۡنٰهُمۡ كَمَا بَلَوۡنَا٘ اَصۡحٰبَ الۡجَنَّةِۚ اِذۡ اَقۡسَمُوۡا لَيَصۡرِمُنَّهَا مُصۡبِحِيۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: We have tested them as We had tested the Owners of the Garden, when they had sworn an oath that they would pluck its fruits on the next morning,
and did not make any exception (by saying inshā’allāh ).

verses.ar: فَطَافَ عَلَيۡهَا طَآئِفٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّكَ وَهُمۡ نَآئِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: Then, there whirled around it a whirl (of calamity) from your Lord, while they were asleep.
Thus, on the next morning, it was like a harvested field.
So, they called out each other as the morning broke,

verses.ar: اَنِ اغۡدُوۡا عَلٰي حَرۡثِكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ صٰرِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: saying, “Set out early, if you are going to pluck (the fruits).”
So they set out while they were whispering to each other,

verses.ar: اَنۡ لَّا يَدۡخُلَنَّهَا الۡيَوۡمَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ مِّسۡكِيۡنٌۙ‏
verses.en: saying, “Let no poor man enter into it upon you today.”
And in early hours they rushed quickly, while they were (assuming themselves) powerful (to pluck the fruits and prevent the poor.)
But when they saw it (the place of the ruined garden), they said, “We have missed the way.”
(Then, once they realized that the garden is the same, but it has been destroyed, they said,) “No, but we are deprived (of the fruits).”

verses.ar: قَالَ اَوۡسَطُهُمۡ اَلَمۡ اَقُلۡ لَّكُمۡ لَوۡلَا تُسَبِّحُوۡنَ
verses.en: Said he who was the best among them, “Did I not say to you, ‘Why do you not pronounce tasbīH (Allah’s purity)?”

verses.ar: قَالُوۡا سُبۡحٰنَ رَبِّنَا٘ اِنَّا كُنَّا ظٰلِمِيۡنَ
verses.en: They said, “We pronounce the purity of our Lord. No doubt, we were wrongdoers.”
Then, (at the beginning,) they started reproaching one another;
(and at last,) they said, “Woe to us! In fact, we (all) were outrageous.

verses.ar: عَسٰي رَبُّنَا٘ اَنۡ يُّبۡدِلَنَا خَيۡرًا مِّنۡهَا٘ اِنَّا٘ اِلٰي رَبِّنَا رٰغِبُوۡنَ
verses.en: We hope that our Lord will give us in exchange something better than this. Truly we turn to Allah.”

verses.ar: كَذٰلِكَ الۡعَذَابُؕ وَلَعَذَابُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَكۡبَرُۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَࣖ‏
verses.en: In this way the punishment comes. And, of course, the punishment of the Hereafter is even greater, if they but realize!

verses.ar: اِنَّ لِلۡمُتَّقِيۡنَ عِنۡدَ رَبِّهِمۡ جَنّٰتِ النَّعِيۡمِ
verses.en: Surely, for the God-fearing there are gardens of bliss.
Otherwise, shall We make the obedient like the sinners?
What has happened to you? How do you judge?
Do you have a book in which you read
that for you there is what you choose?

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَكُمۡ اَيۡمَانٌ عَلَيۡنَا بَالِغَةٌ اِلٰي يَوۡمِ الۡقِيٰمَةِۙ اِنَّ لَكُمۡ لَمَا تَحۡكُمُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Or do you have oaths sworn by Us, remaining effective up to the Day of Judgment, that you will get what you decide?
Ask them which of them stands surety for that.

verses.ar: اَمۡ لَهُمۡ شُرَكَآءُۚۛ فَلۡيَاۡتُوۡا بِشُرَكَآئِهِمۡ اِنۡ كَانُوۡا صٰدِقِيۡنَ
verses.en: Or do they have associate-gods (who have guaranteed safety for them)? Then, let them bring their associate-gods, if they are true.

verses.ar: يَوۡمَ يُكۡشَفُ عَنۡ سَاقٍ وَّيُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَي السُّجُوۡدِ فَلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: On the Day when the Shin will be exposed, and they will be called upon to prostrate themselves, they will not be able to.

verses.ar: خَاشِعَةً اَبۡصَارُهُمۡ تَرۡهَقُهُمۡ ذِلَّةٌؕ وَقَدۡ كَانُوۡا يُدۡعَوۡنَ اِلَي السُّجُوۡدِ وَهُمۡ سٰلِمُوۡنَ
verses.en: With their eyes downcast, they will be enveloped by ignominy. They used to be called upon to prostrate when they were healthy (but they did not.)

verses.ar: فَذَرۡنِيۡ وَمَنۡ يُّكَذِّبُ بِهٰذَا الۡحَدِيۡثِؕ سَنَسۡتَدۡرِجُهُمۡ مِّنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
verses.en: So, leave Me alone with those who reject this discourse. We will draw them on little by little (towards Hell) from a way they do not know.
And I give them respite. Indeed, My plan is firm.

verses.ar: اَمۡ تَسۡـَٔلُهُمۡ اَجۡرًا فَهُمۡ مِّنۡ مَّغۡرَمٍ مُّثۡقَلُوۡنَۚ‏
verses.en: Is it that you ask them for a fee, due to which they are burdened with debt?
Or do they have the (knowledge of the) Unseen, and they write it down?

verses.ar: فَاصۡبِرۡ لِحُكۡمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تَكُنۡ كَصَاحِبِ الۡحُوۡتِۘ اِذۡ نَادٰي وَهُوَ مَكۡظُوۡمٌؕ‏
verses.en: So, remain patient with your Lord’s judgment, and be not like the Man of the Fish, he cried out while he was in anguish.

verses.ar: لَوۡلَا٘ اَنۡ تَدٰرَكَهٗ نِعۡمَةٌ مِّنۡ رَّبِّهٖ لَنُبِذَ بِالۡعَرَآءِ وَهُوَ مَذۡمُوۡمٌ
verses.en: Had not a favour from His Lord come to his help, he would have been cast in the wilderness in a reproachable state.
Then his Lord chose him, and made him one of the righteous.

verses.ar: وَاِنۡ يَّكَادُ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا لَيُزۡلِقُوۡنَكَ بِاَبۡصَارِهِمۡ لَمَّا سَمِعُوا الذِّكۡرَ وَيَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِنَّهٗ لَمَجۡنُوۡنٌۘ‏
verses.en: And indeed the disbelievers seem to trip you up with their glances when they hear the Reminder, and say, “He is a madman indeed.”
And it is nothing else but a Reminder for all the worlds.
